mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id as cartId, c.product_id as productId, c.quantity, c.is_selected as isSelected, c.version, p.name, p.main_image as mainImage, p.price, p.stock, p.status FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_selected = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_selected = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}
